title: India pre-monsoon vegetation greenness (2000-2025)
metric_definition: Share of observed land with NDVI >= 0.40 in the April 15 to May 31 window, from a per-tile median of MODIS MOD13Q1 16-day composites. This is a greenness proxy, not a tree-canopy map: irrigated cropland, plantation and grass all register.
metric_caveat: Cross-decade comparability is limited. Before 2003 the composite holds Terra alone; from 2003 Aqua joins, roughly doubling the scene count and shifting the median slightly. The threshold also sits near the middle of the Indian NDVI distribution, so a small shift in the distribution moves the mapped share sharply. Read the median NDVI series alongside the thresholded series before treating any decade-to-decade step as real greening.
